jamie (devex): Heads-up — running into a pnpm monorepo weirdness when importing the JS SDK from a symlinked workspace in an edge runtime. App fails on startup with an ESM resolution error. Anyone seen this?

jamie (devex): Error: Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: The requested module "@redwood/sdk" does not provide an export named "default"
Importing like: `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`

ryan (eng-runtime): can you paste the package.json for the sdk package (exports + main/module/types)? also Node/pnpm versions + whether you're using preserve-symlinks?

jamie (devex): pnpm 8.2, node 18.16, workspace with symlink (no hoist). SDK package.json snippet:```json
{"name":"@redwood/sdk","version":"0.10.0","main":"dist/cjs/index.js","module":"dist/esm/index.js","types":"dist/index.d.ts","exports":{"./package.json":"./package.json","./dist/esm/index.js":"./dist/esm/index.js"}}```

jamie (devex): note: we only shipped an `./dist/esm/index.js` path under exports, no top-level import/require mapping.

tara (eng-ml): yeah that's the likely culprit. When the package is symlinked pnpm+node ESM resolution can prefer the package root exports mapping. If `exports` doesn't include an entry for the package root with both import/require subpaths Node won't find the default import.

tara (eng-ml): quick suggested exports shape:```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
and ensure `types": "dist/index.d.ts"` at top-level.

ben (devex): For edge runtimes specifically you want a clean ESM entry. But for monorepo symlinks it's important to provide both so tooling / consumers that `require()` or import subpaths still work. Also check that your published package authoring matches local dev: sometimes dist files are missing in workspace and the symlink points to source which isn't ESM-ready.

jamie (devex): interesting. On the sample app we import `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'` — switching to `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.js'` works locally (ugly), so exports mapping seems to be the issue.

ryan (eng-runtime): another angle: Node's symlink resolution + ESM can be affected by `--preserve-symlinks` behavior. If the runtime resolves to the symlink target path then package-relative exports resolution might differ. For dev comfort we recommend either: 1) ensure package root exports include `import`/`require` entries, or 2) run the sample app against a built copy (not source symlink) while debugging.

jamie (devex): typings are also borked when I point at dist/esm — TS can't find the d.ts in some editors because `types` is still referencing cjs layout. I get `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'`.

tara (eng-ml): double-check `types` field points at the d.ts that matches the package root. If you're emitting `dist/index.d.ts` that's the one consumers expect. Some bundlers/TS setups also look at `exports['.'].types` in newer node versions — consider shipping index.d.ts at root or add explicit \"types\": \"dist/index.d.ts\" in package.json.

ben (devex): workaround if you're blocked: add a quick `pnpm -w add -D @redwood/sdk` from the root so pnpm creates a proper entry (forces resolution through registry path), or as jamie did, import direct esm subpath. Both are hacks but unblock CI/dev while we fix exports. Avoid `shamefully-hoist` unless you understand side effects.

jamie (devex): thanks. One more question — is this an SDK bug we should fix in the package.json or a docs/devex-kind-of-thing? I can open a PR.

ryan (eng-runtime): SDK pkg.json fix is the right call. Add the dual `exports` mapping, ensure `module` & `main` point to correct outputs, include `types`, and add a small integration test in the monorepo sample-app that imports from the workspace symlink on Node 18 + edge dev server. CI can run a quick smoke.

ci-bot: deployed quick patch to sample-app that pins import to `./dist/esm/index.js` for now — CI passed :white_check_mark:

jamie (devex): OK I'll draft a tiny SDK change: update exports, add types mapping and a checklist item in devex docs about pnpm symlink pitfalls + preserve-symlinks note. I'll also add a one-liner in the sample-app README explaining the temporary workaround.

tara (eng-ml): and maybe add a unit to our SDK release checklist: verify `exports` has both `import` and `require` and that `./package.json` subpath is exposed. Saves future pain.

ben (devex): also record a note about edge runtime expectations: edge expects native ESM — shipping a clean `import` entry avoids weird fallbacks.

jamie (devex): creating PR now and an issue with reproduction steps + error logs. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:
